title: Lead Generation Discovery Play
content: Start with the advertiser's business objective, conversion event, target customer, budget, measurement readiness and sales cycle. Recommend only approved solutions and document assumptions.

title: Measurement Objection Guide
content: When an advertiser questions measurement, clarify the business outcome, source of truth, attribution window and data availability. Escalate claims that cannot be supported by approved measurement guidance.

title: Retail SMB Discovery Guide
content: For retail advertisers, discover revenue objective, priority products, seasonal calendar, audience, online/offline conversion path and measurement constraints before recommending an activation.

title: Pricing Escalation Policy
content: Do not invent pricing or discounts. Use approved commercial guidance. Route non-standard pricing, contractual exceptions or unsupported commitments to Commercial Operations.

title: AI Usage Standard
content: AI-generated seller guidance is assistive. Sellers remain accountable for customer-facing decisions. Sensitive data must not be entered. High-impact, policy, pricing and legal outputs require human review.

title: Vendor Trainer Certification
content: Vendor trainers must complete approved curriculum, pass proficiency assessment, use current materials and escalate content discrepancies through the defined governance channel.

title: Outdated Product Play
content: This content is expired and must not be surfaced to sellers.

title: Hospitality Discovery Guide
content: For hospitality accounts, identify occupancy or booking objective, target traveller, geography, seasonality, booking journey and measurement capability.
